name: --verbose
-v
options.description: Verbose output to see errors if you need to troubleshoot

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite destination file if it exists. Defaults to appending (n) to the file…

options.name: --hide
options.description: Hide DOM element. Can be set multiple times

options.name: --no-crop
options.description: Override a global crop option within a group

options.name: --css
options.description: Apply custom CSS to the webpage. Specify some CSS or the path to a CSS file

options.name: --cookie
options.description: Browser cookie. Can be set multiple times

options.name: --header
options.description: Custom HTTP request header. Can be set multiple times

options.name: --format
options.description: Image format. Either png (default) or jpg

options.name: --transparent
options.description: Set background color to transparent instead of white if no background is set

options.name: --darkMode
options.description: Emulate preference of dark color scheme
